VC-08.9: "the dev launcher builds profile dev-runtime
(Cargo.toml:301, inherits release but keeps debug-assertions and overflow-checks)"
reason: The diff adds 9 lines (a `[patch.crates-io]` block and its comment) ahead of `[profile.release]` in Cargo.toml, so the dev-runtime profile cited at Cargo.toml:301 moves down by about 9 lines. The profile's behaviour is unchanged and only the line anchor is stale.
